model_claims.text: The original implementation passes an incorrectly sized argument to `fcntl.ioctl` in `bytes_to_read`, causing a buffer overflow on Python 3.14.
model_claims.source_quote: I believe the issue is because the original version passed the incorrect sized `arg` to `fcntl.ioctl`.

model_claims.text: After applying this PR, `bytes_to_read` no longer raises a `SystemError` due to buffer overflow when invoked on Python 3.14.
model_claims.source_quote: I have created this PR which provides correctly sized `arg`.

items.about: Test bytes_to_read for buffer overflow on non-Windows platforms

claims.text: The original implementation passes an incorrectly sized argument to `fcntl.ioctl` in `bytes_to_read`, causing a buffer overflow on Python 3.14.
After applying this PR, `bytes_to_read` no longer raises a `SystemError` due to buffer overflow when invoked on Python 3.14.
